summary.name: AgentSky
summary.one_liner: AgentSky is a hosted place to run agents such as Claude Code, Codex and Hermes from a browser, an API, a Mac app, or chat apps like Slack and Telegram.
use_cases: run Claude Code or Codex tasks from a browser
call agents from your own code via API
use coding agents from Slack or Telegram
run Claude Code locally on a Mac with cloud fallback
summary.what_it_does: AgentSky hosts agents such as Claude Code, Codex and Hermes in one place. Users can run them in a browser, through an API (with a key and linked docs), in the AgentSky Mac app, or from chat channels including iMessage, Telegram, Lark, Slack, Discord and WhatsApp. Cloud agents need no installation. The free Mac app runs Claude Code and Codex on the user's own computer and moves the chat to the cloud when the Mac cannot keep going. Cloud usage is billed for tokens and compute from prepaid credits.
notable: Single place for Claude Code, Codex and Hermes agents
Free Mac app runs Claude Code and Codex locally with cloud handoff
Agents reachable from chat apps like Slack, Telegram and iMessage
New accounts can get up to $12 free credit
caveats: Cloud usage requires prepaid credits for tokens and compute
Local Claude Code and Codex on Mac require the user's own Claude or ChatGPT plan
Local agent runs are limited to Mac according to the page
